verdict.rationale: Superhuman lets users define custom Auto Labels with AI prompts that are applied automatically to incoming email and can drive split-inbox tabs, so a user-defined rule fires an action on email arrival. Auto Archive and auto-drafts are automatic but preset toggles, not user-authored rules, and custom Auto Labels are limited to Business/Enterprise. The whats-new page mentions agents that 'run proactively based on triggers you set' via a visual builder, but this is a single thin mention and it is unclear whether it applies to Mail. Missing for 10: user-defined condition→action rules beyond labeling (e.g., custom archive, forward, reply), documented trigger/event types, clear evidence that the trigger-based agent builder applies to Mail, availability on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
